reading_issues: PDF is a single embedded 994x840 SnowPilot raster, extracted at native resolution. Hardness bar edges and layer boundaries measured from pixels against the axis ticks; boundaries are integer cm (outline rows at 70.0, 50.0 and 10.0 cm). Temperature axis spans -15 to 0 degC (28.9 px/degC; labels every 2 degC); the highest temperature dot is at 70 cm, none at the surface (84 cm). The moisture column is blank on this chart. The "Oct Crust" layer note covers 0-10 cm but the grain form there is FC(DH), not a crust glyph; grain is recorded as drawn. The red line across the top of the 0-10 cm layer is the problematic-layer flag. CTN arrow sits at the ground of the tests column (no failure height), so height/depth are null. Sizes of the form "a(b)" recorded as the primary form size. Elevation printed 2400 m (other visits print 2280, 2295 and 2300 m). The chart title reads "Goats Eye Plot".
